name: pixel-buddies
description: An animated pixel-art buddy with its own personality and a life of its own. It reacts to your work, earns new looks, celebrates the seasons, and lives its own story: pick an adventure and build its world as you code.

chattiness.title: Chattiness
chattiness.description: How much your buddy talks: silent (animations only), quiet (big moments), normal, or chaotic.

sleepAfterMinutes.title: Fall asleep after (minutes idle)
sleepAfterMinutes.description: Minutes without activity before your buddy dozes off. 0 never sleeps.
